values: Stop splitting when the unit has one clear trigger, one bounded input class or invariant, one observable output/contract, known side effects, and direct pass/fail/inconclusive criteria.
Split by observable behavior: input class, execution mode, output/evidence contract, side-effect policy, lifecycle stage, and failure/recovery mode.
Split by invariant: route/binding, capability/operator mapping, evidence schema, evaluator gate, gate policy mode, side-effect class, TaskGraph/resume/artifact contract.
Split by product surface: component, lifecycle command, platform, UI surface, integration/provider boundary, hook trigger, CI job, packaging/release behavior.
Every nonblank level n+1 feature is a child of the feature immediately to its left in the same row.
The rightmost nonblank level feature in a row is intended to be a base-case testable behavior/invariant, not merely a file or function name.
A correct test outcome can be completed, failed-correctly, inconclusive-correctly, blocked-correctly, approval-required-correctly, skipped-correctly, or static-validation-required.
